version_status: VRS 2.0 official release; VRS 2.1 community-review ballot pending
claim_check: Official specification defines language-neutral molecular variation, sequence locations, normalization and computed identifiers
limitations: Active development requires exact release and maturity pins

claim_check: Official protocol defines digest-derived sequence identity, normalization, metadata and ranged retrieval
limitations: Protocol identity does not replace archive accession or authorization

claim_check: Official specification defines collection digests, completeness levels, coordinate-system views and compatibility comparison
limitations: Pangenomes remain in process and compatibility is profile-dependent

claim_check: Official recommendations require an accepted immutable reference and distinguish measured from predicted consequence expressions
limitations: Expression validity is not biological or clinical truth

claim_check: Official specification defines file metadata, coordinates, alleles, symbolic forms and genotype fields
limitations: VCF records are format-level representations and require file and reference context

claim_check: Official site confirms shared submission, validation, controlled-vocabulary, assembly and representation specifications
limitations: Member databases and living documents require exact profile pins

claim_check: Official source confirms curated reference sequence records and accession-version use
limitations: Reference status and annotation can evolve while prior versions remain significant

claim_check: Official service exposes SPDI normalization and variation translation operations
limitations: API version zero and algorithm behavior require captured request and release context

claim_check: Official model separates submissions, variant aggregates and variant-condition aggregates with observations
limitations: Clinical archive aggregation is not molecular identity or patient-specific interpretation

claim_check: Official source distinguishes germline, somatic clinical-impact and oncogenicity classifications
limitations: Terminology and aggregation rules evolve and remain condition-contextual

claim_check: Official source defines VCF submissions, normalization, SS and RS accessions, species scope and merge history
limitations: Human and non-human accession authority differs and controlled-access data belongs elsewhere

claim_check: Official ontology defines sequence features, alterations and molecular consequence classes
limitations: Ontology release and annotation-tool versions must be pinned

version_status: Living guidance accessed 7 September 2026; SVI reorganized in 2025
claim_check: Official resources provide evidence-criterion and expert-panel specifications
limitations: Gene and disease specifications vary and do not define molecular identity

claim_check: Official guideline defines five-tier Mendelian classification and evidence categories
limitations: Human clinical scope is narrower than all genomic variation and revision is pending

claim_check: Official resource represents one molecular sequence in clinical exchange
limitations: Maturity level 1 Trial Use and patient security category require caution

claim_check: Official product defines machine-readable data-use permissions and modifiers
limitations: Ontology tags support but do not themselves grant access

claim_check: Official framework defines responsible sharing, consent, privacy, security and governance principles
limitations: Framework complements rather than replaces applicable law and institutional policy

claim_check: Official ontology defines derivation, attribution, revision and invalidation
limitations: Generic provenance needs genomic domain profiles

claim_check: Official vocabulary defines quality measurements, annotations, standards and provenance
limitations: Note status and domain metrics require local validation

claim_check: Official model defines permissions, prohibitions, duties and constraints
limitations: Policy expression is not authorization enforcement

claim_check: Official RFC defines timestamps with seconds and explicit offset or Z
limitations: Domain event semantics and precision remain model responsibilities

claim_check: Official RFC defines deterministic JSON canonicalization
limitations: Canonical JSON does not establish semantic identity by itself

claim_check: Official specification defines linked-data identity and typed JSON projections
limitations: Context versions and graph transformations can introduce semantic loss

claim_check: Official repository defines federated genomic discovery requests and responses
limitations: Discovery exposure and implementation versions require privacy and conformance review
